'''Lyla''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] residing on [[Makeb]] with her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Suz-Anz]]. The two were outcasts, and both eventually fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. They meditated on Makeb together until [[3638 BBY]], when both were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lyla appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a miniboss on Makeb alongside her Master, Suz-Anz. She is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means she was killed.
